LanguageData.ABY_CrownInterdicted.label: crown interdicted
LanguageData.ABY_CrownInterdicted.description: The target has been indexed by a Crown lockframe. Its motion is treated as a violation of the local geometry until the writ decays.
LanguageData.ABY_CrownInterdicted_Boss.label: crown interdicted
LanguageData.ABY_CrownInterdicted_Boss.description: A protected target has resisted the full edict. The lockframe can still disturb its movement and combat rhythm, but cannot turn its encounter logic into a stun loop.
LanguageData.ABY_CrownAuthorityScar.label: authority scar
LanguageData.ABY_CrownAuthorityScar.description: The target still carries the residue of an imposed Crown edict. A second lockframe cannot immediately write the same order into the same body.
